summary.text: Derrick Hall is a Democratic state representative from Ohio who has represented District 34 since January 1, 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A pharmacist, attorney and U.S. Army Reserve veteran, he is the ranking member of the Veterans and Military Development Committee.

paragraphs.text: Derrick Hall earned a Pharm.D., J.D. and M.B.A. from The Ohio State University and a master's degree from Harvard Medical School, according to Ballotpedia.
He served in the U.S. Army Reserve as a JAG officer, and Ballotpedia lists the Akron Public Schools board of education, at-large, among his prior offices.
Hall assumed office in the Ohio House of Representatives on January 1, 2025, and advanced from the Democratic primary on May 5, 2026.
In the 2025-2026 session he serves on the Energy, Medicaid and House Ways and Means committees and is the ranking member of the Veterans and Military Development Committee.
Craig Shubert (R) is the other candidate in the November 3, 2026 general election.
